description_html:
The OXVA NeXLIM Replacement Pod is a refillable replacement pod for compatible OXVA devices.

  • Product Type: Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Built-in Coil)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 2mL / 4mL (varies by pod)
  • Coil Resistance: 0.6Ω / 0.8Ω / 1.2Ω (built-in, varies by pod)
  • Coil Material: Dual Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: OXVA NeXLIM (also fits XLIM devices via adaptor)
  • Brand: OXVA

Coil is built in - replace the pod when flavour fades. E-liquid sold separately.

Available options: 0.6 ohm (4mL), 0.8 ohm (4mL), 1.2 ohm (4mL), 0.6 ohm (2mL), 0.8 ohm (2mL), 1.2 ohm (2mL).
